rationale: The bid-ask spread of 164 bps is prohibitively wide for intraday trading, creating an immediate structural disadvantage that would require a significant move just to break even. Volume is extremely thin at ~40K shares with only two visible candles, making reliable price discovery difficult and exit risk high. The -6.92% gap down with no news context and erratic early price action (large first candle, then pullback) provides no clean directional thesis to exploit.
